description: Reference schema for the jd_embeddings pgvector table. Rows are produced by app.chunking.jd_chunker.chunk_jd_json() using RecursiveJsonSplitter, then stored via app.db.pgvector_client.upsert_jd_embeddings(). Criteria values follow the enterprise rich-dict format produced by the 14-phase weight assignment pipeline.

splitter_config.description: Splits JD weight JSON by section boundaries. Each chunk represents one scoring section plus its criteria and weight metadata.

jd_id.description: Unique identifier for the job description (typically jd_content_hash from Phase 14 output)

chunk_index.description: 0-based sequential index of the chunk within this JD

dimension.description: Section name this chunk covers. One of: technologies, skills, tools, certifications, experience, qualification, position, relevant_experience, responsibilities, salary, domain_fit.

chunk_text.description: Serialised JSON string of the chunk data produced by split_json_to_chunks()

chunk_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of chunk_text. Used for deduplication on upsert.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached by the chunker (e.g. section name, weight, jd_id)

enterprise_rich_dict.description: Produced by the 14-phase weight assignment pipeline (Phase 7 criteria score generation + Phase 14 audit metadata injection)

schema.reasoning_label: string — one of 7 ontology labels: mandatory_core_skill, critical_requirement, important_skill, preferred_skill, supporting_skill, nice_to_have, irrelevant
schema.confidence: float — LLM confidence in reasoning_label assignment (0.0–1.0)
schema.evidence: string — text from JD that supports the label assignment

example.evidence: Must have 5+ years of Python experience for backend development

legacy_plain_number.description: Pre-enterprise format. Criteria value is a plain float (0–100). Still accepted by rag_validation._extract_criterion_meta() for backwards compatibility.

label_multiplier_table.description: Deterministic multipliers from Phase 6. Score = BASE_SCORE(100) × multiplier.

technologies_section.text: {"section": "technologies", "weight": 22.5, "weight_generation_metadata": {"raw_weight": 185.0, "criteria_count": 4, "section_importance_factor": 1.28, "normalization_factor": 1048.3}, "criteria": {"Python": {"score": 100.0, "reasoning_label": "mandatory_core_skill", "multiplier": 1.0, "confidence": 0.97, "evidence": "Required: Python 3.8+"}, "FastAPI": {"score": 95.0, "reasoning_label": "critical_requirement", "multiplier": 0.95, "confidence": 0.91, "evidence": "Primary API framework"}, "Docker": {"score": 80.0, "reasoning_label": "important_skill", "multiplier": 0.80, "confidence": 0.88, "evidence": "Containerisation required"}, "Kubernetes": {"score": 70.0, "reasoning_label": "preferred_skill", "multiplier": 0.70, "confidence": 0.85, "evidence": "K8s preferred for deployment"}}, "jd_items": ["Python", "FastAPI", "Docker", "Kubernetes"], "source": "jd", "chunk_index": 0, "chunk_hash": "a1b2..."}
technologies_section.notes: One chunk per scoring section. Criteria use enterprise rich-dict format.

experience_section.text: {"section": "experience", "weight": 18.3, "weight_generation_metadata": {"raw_weight": 148.2, "criteria_count": 4, "section_importance_factor": 0.90, "normalization_factor": 1048.3}, "criteria": {">=8 years": {"score": 35.0, "reasoning_label": "nice_to_have", "multiplier": 0.35, "confidence": 0.80, "evidence": "Overqualified for this role"}, "5-7 years": {"score": 100.0, "reasoning_label": "mandatory_core_skill", "multiplier": 1.0, "confidence": 0.95, "evidence": "Requires 5-7 years experience"}, "3-4 years": {"score": 55.0, "reasoning_label": "supporting_skill", "multiplier": 0.55, "confidence": 0.87, "evidence": "3-4 years acceptable"}, "<3 years": {"score": 0.0, "reasoning_label": "irrelevant", "multiplier": 0.0, "confidence": 0.99, "evidence": "Under-qualified"}}, "jd_items": [">=8 years", "5-7 years", "3-4 years", "<3 years"], "source": "jd", "chunk_index": 2, "chunk_hash": "c3d4..."}
experience_section.notes: Fixed-bucket section. Buckets not matching JD requirement get irrelevant/low labels.

domain_fit_chunk.text: {"section": "domain_fit", "job_title": "Senior Backend Engineer", "job_description": "We are looking for an experienced backend engineer to lead our API platform...", "responsibilities": ["Design and implement RESTful APIs", "Maintain CI/CD pipelines", "Lead code reviews"], "employment_type": "full-time", "work_mode": {"remote_option": true, "work_from_office": false, "hybrid": false}, "source": "jd", "chunk_index": 10, "chunk_hash": "e5f6..."}
domain_fit_chunk.notes: Non-scoring domain context chunk. Used for semantic JD–resume matching at the role level.

chunker_input.description: chunk_jd_json(jd_normalized: dict, jd_weights: dict) — jd_normalized is the flat extracted JD dict; jd_weights is the Phase 14 enterprise weight output.

schema.text: string — serialised JSON string of chunk data
schema.chunk_hash: string — SHA-256 hex of text field

search_result_row.description: Row format returned by app.db.pgvector_client.search_jd_embeddings(jd_id, query_embedding, dimension, top_k)

upsert_behaviour.on_conflict: DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, chunk_text = EXCLUDED.chunk_text, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
upsert_behaviour.description: Idempotent upsert. Re-processing the same JD (same jd_content_hash) only updates rows where criteria content changed.

weighting_metadata_propagation.description: The weighting_metadata block from Phase 14 output is NOT embedded directly. Instead, its key fields (section_importance_factor, mathematical_validation.is_valid) are propagated to rag_validation.py at scoring time via the jd_weights argument to _run_mathematical_validation().

fields_propagated.section_importance_factor: Used to scale R001 threshold and compute importance-weighted MAE
fields_propagated.mathematical_validation.is_valid: Stored as jd_weights_math_valid in rag_final_verdict and final score result
